source: Arabic lifted verbatim from the MIT-licensed 'hadith' package (62,178 narrations, nine collections) between two anchors, and each line then found again in the public-domain hadith-api dataset (github.com/fawazahmed0/hadith-api, Unlicense), which had no part in the lift. Not one word was typed from memory. English: a plain rendering written for this app, not a published translation. DRAFT: the English, the choice of where each du'a starts and stops, and which kind each one is filed under all need a qualified reviewer. 'ref' names the collection the wording was lifted from, not a hadith number -- those need checking on sunnah.com one at a time.

items.title: Morning has come, and the dominion is Allah's
items.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ

text.en: We have entered upon the morning, and the dominion belongs to Allah.

items.title: Evening has come, and the dominion is Allah's
items.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ

text.en: We have entered upon the evening, and the dominion belongs to Allah. Praise belongs to Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, who has no partner.

items.title: By You we wake and by You we sleep
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ

text.en: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the return.

items.title: In Your name I die and I live
items.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا

text.en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

items.title: In Your name I live and I die
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَحْيَا وَبِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ

text.en: O Allah, in Your name I live and in Your name I die.

items.title: Praise to Him who gave us life again
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ

text.en: Praise belongs to Allah, who gave us life after He had caused us to die, and to Him is the rising.

items.title: Waking in the night
items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ

text.en: There is no god but Allah alone, who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. Glory be to Allah, and praise belongs to Allah, and Allah is greatest, and there is no power and no strength except by Allah.

items.title: After eating
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا الطَّعَامَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ

text.en: Praise belongs to Allah, who fed me this and provided it for me with no strength or power of my own.

items.title: Bless this for us
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ

text.en: O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it.

items.title: Going in
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلَجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا

text.en: O Allah, I ask You for the best of entrances and the best of exits. In the name of Allah we enter, and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we rely.

items.title: Setting out
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ

text.en: In the name of Allah. I rely upon Allah. There is no power and no strength except by Allah.

items.title: Going into the mosque
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ

text.en: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

items.title: Coming out of the mosque
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ

text.en: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

items.title: Setting off on a journey
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنْ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى

text.en: O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and mindfulness of You, and for deeds that please You.

items.title: Make the journey easy
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ

text.en: O Allah, make this journey of ours easy for us, and fold up its distance for us.

items.title: Companion on the road
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ

text.en: O Allah, You are the companion on the journey and the guardian of the family left behind.

items.title: The perfect words of Allah
items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

text.en: I take refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

items.title: From worry and grief
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ

text.en: O Allah, I take refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and idleness, from cowardice and miserliness, from being weighed down by debt and overpowered by men.

items.title: Take away the harm
items.arabic: أَذْهِبْ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا

text.en: Take away the harm, Lord of mankind, and heal; You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing -- a healing that leaves no illness behind.

items.title: For somebody who is ill
items.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ

text.en: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal you.

items.title: Help me to remember You
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ

text.en: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.

items.title: Benefit me by what You taught me
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا

text.en: O Allah, benefit me by what You have taught me, teach me what benefits me, and increase me in knowledge.

items.title: The best way of asking pardon
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

text.en: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I hold to Your covenant and Your promise as much as I can. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin; forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.
